scope: Individual source-module validation evidence; not a complete project or EXPANSION theorem certificate.

environment.ci_build_method: lake build with repository Lake options and original source imports

definitions.Built: Lake explicitly completed a fresh build action for this module.
definitions.Replayed_or_Reused: Lake explicitly accepted a prior build action; this is not a fresh compiler execution.
definitions.Ran: Unknown/auxiliary Lake job action. Import-header warnings can produce this status before compilation; it is not counted as a module compile pass.
definitions.silent_target: No individual successful compile evidence is inferred from absence of an error.
definitions.source_match: SHA-256 of exact Lean source bytes; this alone does not certify unchanged transitive dependencies.
definitions.local_strict_pass: Compiler exit zero on current source, explicit strict implicit flags, and current artifact/direct dependency hashes match the recorded native run.
definitions.print_axioms: Successful #print axioms for named declarations only; distinct from the generated exhaustive audit.

ci_jobs.cancellation_reason: Superseded by checkpoint6 under the existing workflow concurrency setting; no Lean error was emitted before cancellation.

resource_cancellations.reason: Local legacy import exceeded 200 GB physical reads without a proof diagnostic; the task stopped this process and used CI for the actual dependency graph.

existing_same_branch_actual_cache.use: Read-only restore-key fallback to an existing same-branch, same-environment project cache. Save and upload steps are unchanged.
existing_same_branch_actual_cache.validation_boundary: Lake must still validate dependency traces and compile changed source. Cache presence alone is not a theorem certificate.

limitations: The current proof bodies and original data constructors are written, but their native compilation and strict original-target audit have not yet succeeded.
Historical successful source or axiom records do not validate modified source or changed transitive dependencies.
The separate HighBin and Moments analytic obligations remain outside EXPANSION scope; the original EX-TAIL consumes its unchanged boundary hypothesis.
Failed, cancelled, Ran-only, and not-yet-built declarations are not counted as passed.
Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound are allowed by every strict EXPANSION gate.
